conditions.description: Pin the regenerated first-public-release Starlight v1 review bundle, while retaining the previous approval and historical input/evidence records separately in the pre-v1-reset archive.

Authorized scope is the pinned compact pair and channels. Original catalogues, SVO transmission curves, spectral files and per-star diagnostics are excluded from runtime packages.

The maintainer expressly accepts the pinned rights assessment conclusions: the new integrated map does not publicly reutilize a substantial protected part of XHIP, and the independently generated numerical map retains separate scientific-data terms when embedded in the AGPL library. EU database and GNU same-executable counterarguments were disclosed. No third-party right is waived or invented; retain maintainer-provided SVO/Hipparcos correspondence. No national domicile is inferred from account or timezone.
Production registration does not claim publication. Mutable publication metadata must be derived and verified against the unchanged approval snapshot, decision and exact product.
